updates.trialName: Study of ORM-1153 in Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) With CD123 Expression
updates.diagnosis: Relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML) or other CD123-expressing hematologic malignancies
updates.eligibility: Adults with relapsed/refractory AML and any detectable level of CD123 on local assessment; TP53 mutation is preclinical rationale, NOT a confirmed required enrollment biomarker; excludes acute promyelocytic leukemia.

molecularEligibility.required: detectable CD123 expression (any level by local assessment)

updates.intervention: ORM-1153 intravenous infusion; CD123-targeting antibody conjugated to GSPT1 protein degrader via cleavable beta-glucuronide linker
updates.mechanism: CD123-directed degrader-antibody conjugate; intracellular GSPT1 degradation
updates.studyDesign: First-in-human, open-label, sequential dose escalation; approximately 42 planned participants
institution: START - Midwest, Grand Rapids, Michigan, USA
MD Anderson Cancer Center, Houston, Texas, USA
geography: United States: Michigan, Texas (two named registry sites)

endpoint.primary: Optimal biological dose(s) of ORM-1153 (approximately 24 months)
endpoint.additional: Safety and tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, preliminary antileukemic activity (sponsor-described; full registry endpoint specifications not directly reverified)

status.sponsorObserved: First participant dosed; sponsor announcement Oct 13, 2026 at 19:00 ET / Oct 14, 2026 on official sponsor newsroom
status.registryReported: Not yet recruiting; September 9, 2026 last-posted record, via two independent registry mirrors
status.reconciliation: UNRESOLVED: first patient dosing occurred after the September record; no verified ClinicalTrials.gov status change; do not label recruiting without official reconciliation
status.results: No human efficacy or safety data disclosed
status.studyStart: December 1, 2026 estimated in stale September registry record; contradicted by October 2026 first-patient dosing

updates.eventDatePrecision: announcement date; actual administration date not specified
updates.event: Orum announced first patient dosed in Phase 1 first-in-human ORM-1153 trial. Material first-in-human milestone for CD123/GSPT1-targeted AML program.

provenance.verification: Direct record/API inaccessible during this run; authoritative status not independently confirmed

updates.limitations: Uncontrolled Phase 1; no posted clinical efficacy results, safety outcomes or proof of benefit. September registry record predates sponsor's October dosing announcement; actual recruitment opening, actual start date and direct ClinicalTrials.gov registry state await verification.
